title: Close-break, reclaim and wick sweep of a swing level on W, 1D, 4h, 1h and 15m: fee-net follow / fade trade, DEV and VALIDATION

what.name: Source
what.value_plain: operator ask T058 (broken lows and highs by timeframe), no trader transcript (NO-SOURCE)
what.label: OURS

what.name: Swing and break
what.value_plain: fractal swing (W2, 1D3, 4h3, 1h5, 15m5 bars each side), first pierce consumes the level; close beyond by 0.1 ATR = break, else W1 wick sweep; R if a close is back inside within N bars (W2, 1D3, 4h6, 1h6, 15m8), else H
what.label: OURS

what.name: Trade
what.value_plain: H: follow the break; R: fade it; W1: fade the pierce; entry at the open after the class is known, exit after 4 bars
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: Binance taker 0.05% per side on both legs (backtest/fees.py regime A, 0.10% round trip), no slippage
what.label: SOURCED

how: Event study on BTCUSDT 1m bars aggregated to each timeframe; events counted per pierce of a live swing level, not per bar. Week-block bootstrap 95% CI. Pseudo-level control and indicator state before, at and after are in output.md.
window: DEV 2022-01-01 to 2024-06-30 and VALIDATION 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30; HOLDOUT never loaded

verdict.label: No fee-net edge at any timeframe (15m FAIL, 1h and 4h INCONCLUSIVE, W and 1D too few events)

why: At 15m, following a held break, fading a reclaimed break and fading a wick sweep are each negative after fees in DEV and VALIDATION with a CI that excludes zero (e.g. wick sweep DEV -0.122%, VAL -0.103%).
At 1h and 4h the fee-net means sit around zero and every CI spans zero, so no claim either way; W (17 events) and 1D (122 events) are too few.

Most pierces are wick sweeps (55-60% of events at 4h, 1h and 15m); hold share among close-breaks falls with shorter timeframe (4h 50/44%, 1h 46/43%, 15m 36/35% DEV/VAL) and is close to a random-level control.

examples.caption: percent only; CI = week-block bootstrap 95%, shown when n >= 10
